speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have presented, but I have no record of your symptoms or medical history yet. To begin our evaluation, can you describe the skin lesion you are concerned about, including when it first appeared and how it has changed?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

Given your age, significant smoking history, and the location of a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on your penis, along with a similar lesion on your finger that failed previous treatments, I am highly concerned for malignancy. Can you describe the size of the lesions in millimeters and whether they are bleeding or painful?
